project.name: Hydranten Jäger
project.description: Mobile app for viewing, adding, and editing fire hydrants, water sources, and AEDs in OpenStreetMap.

tags.description: Queries and edits water suction points.
Queries and edits cisterns and other water tanks.
Queries and edits AEDs (automated external defibrillators).
Reads and edits hydrant types, including pillar, underground, wall, and dry hydrant. Existing other values are preserved.
Reads and edits hydrant position. The form offers sidewalk, lane, parking_lane, and green; street is normalized to lane.
Reads and edits the hydrant diameter.
Reads and edits whether an underground hydrant's diameter is shown on its sign.
Reads and edits the water source, with form values main, groundwater, pond, lake, river, and reservoir.
Reads and edits water tank volume.
Reads and edits AED access conditions.
Reads and edits whether an AED is located indoors.
Reads and edits the opening hours that apply to an AED.
Reads and edits the hydrant or water tank reference.
Reads and writes the legacy sign marker when an underground hydrant diameter is not signed.
Reads and edits the note field.
Reads legacy descriptions into the note field when editing; new edits are saved as note.
